name: Kaylee Egerer
detail: The Herald of 22 Feb 2011 captions her Campus Improvements Chair, a term the archive does not record. It has her in 2008-09 and 2011-12 only, so her portrait had to be filed to the latter.

name: Paige Settles
detail: Recorded twice in the same year, as Page Settles and Paige Settles, both Speaker of the Senate. One person, two spellings. Her own progression, freshman senator in 2012-13, confirms the Herald was right to call her a senior in September 2015 and wrong to call her a junior the following March.
